items.title: EBay Stock Falls After Report That GameStop Weighing Dropping Bid
items.summary: Shares of eBay were down around 3% in morning trading after a report that GameStop is weighing withdrawing its bid for the online auction company. GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen is considering proposing a partnership or joint venture that would let eBay use GameStop's retail locations, Bloomberg reported.
